name: Comment on Jira Issue
description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue. Use to comment on, reply to, or add a note to an issue.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKey.description: The Jira issue key, e.g. 'ENG-123'. Required.

body.description: The comment text (plain text / Jira wiki markup). Required.

examples.prompt: comment on ENG-42 that the fix is deployed
